subject: Acme Payments — security discovery follow-up & pen-test deliverables
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acme-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from discovery — SOC2, GDPR, pen test info request

Jordan — thanks again for the demo and the quick overview today. Two quick follow-ups from our security & procurement folks so we can move the eval forward: 

1) SOC 2 status & timeline — do you have a SOC 2 Type II report or an expected audit date?
2) Vendor security questionnaire — we'd like to kick off our standard security questionnaire (I can send ours but prefer a short intake first).
3) Pen test evidence — can you share (a) latest summary of any third-party or internal penetration tests, (b) your vulnerability remediation SLA (what % of critical/major bugs are fixed within X days), and (c) scanner cadence (monthly/quarterly?) and CVE disclosure policy.

If easier, loop in your security lead and I can set a 30-min follow-up for next week. We’re targeting a pilot in June.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Security & Compliance
Acme Payments

--
Attachment: acme_questionnaire_v1.docx (placeholder)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acme-payments.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — SOC2, GDPR, pen test info request

Elena — great to meet you and appreciate the clarity. Recap and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type I (security) with Type II expected Q3 2026. We can provide the Type I report and our controls matrix now; Type II audit window is June–Aug and we’ll share the report once complete.

- Vendor questionnaire: happy to start. Monica, can you take the intake and share our standard questionnaire bundle + the intake form link?

- Pen test & vuln program: Rishi will attach our high-level pen-test summary and the remediation SLA proposal. Short answers: we run third-party pen tests annually, internal rolling scans monthly, and aim to remediate critical findings within 7 business days and high/medium per SLA tiers (see attached triage template). We also maintain a disclosure contact and coordinate CVE handling with customers for any customer-impacting findings.

Proposed next steps:
1) Rishi to send the redacted pen-test summary + triage template (today).
2) Monica to start the questionnaire intake and share a link (EOD).
3) Optional 30-min call with Rishi and our infra lead if you want deeper tech Qs — suggest Wednesday 5/13 10am PT.

If that works, I’ll calendar the slot.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachments: RISK-Triage-Template.xlsx (spreadsheet placeholder)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-payments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — pen-test summary + vuln program

Hi Elena — attaching a redacted summary of our most recent third-party assessment (Nov 2025) and a short FAQ below. See attachments for the triage template we use with customers.

Key bullets: 
- Latest third-party pen-test: Nov 2025, no critical findings affecting multi-tenant isolation or key material flows; several medium findings (auth/config) that were remediated within our SLA window. Redacted summary attached: acme_pen_test_summary_2025-11.pdf
- Scanning cadence: weekly automated scans (SAST/DAST on CI + infra scans), monthly full vulnerability scans, quarterly dependency/software composition reviews, annual third-party pen test.
- Remediation SLA (recommended for vendor contracts): Critical: 7 business days; High: 14 business days; Medium: 30 business days; Low: tracked in backlog. We can include SLA language in the MSA if needed.
- Disclosure policy: We follow coordinated disclosure. Customers are notified immediately for any findings that could impact their data; we publish a timeline to affected parties and work on CVE assignment as applicable.

If you need the unredacted report we require an NDA and a work product sharing agreement — common practice for pen-test artifacts. Happy to start that process if Acme needs the full report.

Proposed technical call topics if you take the 30-min slot: architecture boundary of customer data flows, network isolation model for Dedicated deployments, KV/cache encryption, and our audit log retention.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Engineering
redwood.inference.com

--
Attachment: acme_pen_test_summary_2025-11.pdf (redacted summary)
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-payments.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from discovery — SOC2, GDPR, pen test info request

Jordan / Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups from procurement/security: 

- We’ll review the redacted pen-test summary internally. If we request the unredacted report we’ll send an NDA draft by EOD so you can confirm.
- On the SLA tiers: the remediation windows look reasonable; can you confirm whether those SLAs are contractual (MSA) level or internal targets? We prefer contract language for High/Critical for pilot customers.
- Questionnaire: Monica, please share the intake link and expected turnaround for the completed vendor questionnaire (we prefer <5 business days).

Would like to accept the 5/13 10am PT slot for a quick tech sync with Rishi and your infra lead — we’ll prepare 3 technical confirmation questions.

Best,
Tom Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Payments
